results.title: The Sting
results.overview: Lucien is on vacation in the country with his mother and grandmother. He finally decides to write to his uncle. When his mother finds out, she explodes with rage.

results.title: Bison Kaalamaadan
results.overview: A young man fights to overcome violence plaguing his village and succeed as a professional kabaddi player.

results.title: Memorias Encuadradas
results.overview: One hundred years of the cinematic memory of a small country told through motion graphics. A brief tour of previously unseen images and forgotten fragments of Costa Rican cinema, which, amid state efforts and industrial ambitions, prevailed throughout the 20th century.

results.title: Secret Door
results.overview: Ham Jae-kyeong, a successful adult web novel writer, suddenly finds herself in a slump. She rewrites her writing and characters keep overlapping.  Se-hee, the CEO of a web novel company, is Jae-kyeong’s friend.  Se-hee suggests to Jae-kyeong that she write a SM novel as a way to overcome her slump.  At first, she refuses, but after being persuaded by her assistant writer, Gi-dong, she meets Seong-soo, who enjoys SM play.  Jae-kyeong is drawn to the handsome and well-mannered Seong-soo. Is he researching for her novel or is he in a relationship?  Growing increasingly captivated by Seong-soo’s charm, she begins to embrace SM play.

results.title: The Last Supper
results.overview: In a deserted house, a mysterious man savors an exquisite menu in the company of an unseen guest. From this eerie dinner table, a succession of terrifying stories is revealed-each probing primal fears of hunger, flesh, and survival.

results.title: My Mom Jayne
results.overview: Through deeply personal interviews with her siblings and an examination of the photographs, letters, and belongings left behind, Mariska assembles a new portrait of her mother Jayne Mansfield, an extraordinary and complex woman.

results.title: Fishgirl
results.overview: Camila suffers from amnesia and has filled the emptiness in her life with an imaginary world where a giant fish acts as her guardian. She escapes into this dreamlike realm to flee from a blurry past. However, when the boy she loves disappears, she must embark on a journey to find him and uncover what lies hidden between dreams, the fantastical, the past, and the future.

results.title: Half Moon
results.overview: An elegiac documentary following virtuosic clarinettist and composer Kinan Azmeh, a Damascus-born musician living in exile, as he attempts to find meaning and purpose after the outbreak of war in Syria. A profound exploration of the role art can play in forging identity and community.

results.title: Pura Sangre
results.overview: A young man sneaks into the estate of a family that hates him.

results.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
results.original_title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
results.overview: The now estranged bandmates of Spinal Tap are forced to reunite for one final concert, hoping it will solidify their place in the pantheon of rock 'n' roll.

results.title: Into the Deep
results.overview: Divers searching for sunken treasure witness the murder of drug dealers by modern-day pirates, but a killer great white is determined not to let any of them escape its waters.

results.title: Curtain
results.overview: Samet invites his friends over to celebrate his promotion to general manager. While feeding the cats before entering the house, he sees the woman on the ground floor undressing and runs away when she notices him, which leads to the doorman being blamed. His wife Zeynep, who has always defended the doorman while discussing this issue with her friends, will she defend what she believes is right when she learns that Samet is the real culprit? Or will she protect her interests?

results.title: Kama
results.overview: An unexpected discovery pushes a vengeful, battle-hardened soldier into tracking down a charismatic movie star — the man he suspects of having a secret, whirlwind romance with his wife.

results.title: Earworm
results.overview: Ulph (Adam Lundgren) is in the hospital since he suffered from a serious form of earworm. Rednex's unmistakable "Cotton Eye Joe" ruins his life and drives him to the brink of insanity. The all-too-familiar phenomenon takes on physical form in Patrik Eklund's psychological thriller with a comic undertone.

results.title: My Father's Shadow
results.overview: Two young brothers explore Lagos with their estranged father during the 1993 Nigerian election crisis, witnessing both the city's magnitude and their father's daily struggles as political unrest threatens their journey home.

results.title: The Biggest Fan
results.overview: Canceled in Hollywood, star Lana Cruz heads to her hometown for a comeback. Enter Polly, her fan-turned-frenemy. Can Lana dodge drama and reclaim her fame?

results.title: Political Cinema
results.overview: Through abrupt soundtrack shifts, this short film jumps between historical political imagery to explore the cinematic language of propaganda, unpacking complex concepts through sensory explosions — from the Brazilian military dictatorship to the Chinese revolution.

results.title: New City
results.overview: Documentary filmmaker Johan returns to his hometown of Amsterdam, now transformed by gentrification, to hold up a mirror to the city. There, he is distracted from his goal: Johan must first confront himself.

results.title: Ligaya
results.overview: A former bar entertainer now lives a quiet life with her husband - until he loses his job. To survive, she returns to the world of adult entertainment, entering a voyeuristic club where everything slowly begins to fall apart.

results.title: Die Slow
results.overview: In a sinister underground game, troubled girls and men are gassed, boxed, and forced to fight in a deadly maze, battling inner demons while hunting for clues to survive. Controlled by an unseen sadistic mastermind, they navigate a nightmarish labyrinth.
